# kWh Ranked

> Running costs of appliances and cars computed from government energy data, with the math shown

Every page here computes what an appliance costs to run from government and certification data (ENERGY STAR, DOE, EIA), with the formula and the raw table shown so you can check it. We do not list prices, which change daily.

## Rankings

- [The most efficient electric cars, ranked by EPA kWh per 100 miles with the monthly cost to charge at home](https://kwhranked.com/most-efficient-electric-cars/): updated 2026-11-05, next refresh 2026-12-05; data [CSV](https://kwhranked.com/data/most-efficient-electric-cars.csv) [JSON](https://kwhranked.com/data/most-efficient-electric-cars.json)
- [The most efficient full-size heat pump dryers, ranked by certified CEF with the yearly cost to run](https://kwhranked.com/most-efficient-heat-pump-dryers/): updated 2026-11-05, next refresh 2026-12-05; data [CSV](https://kwhranked.com/data/most-efficient-heat-pump-dryers.csv) [JSON](https://kwhranked.com/data/most-efficient-heat-pump-dryers.json)
